u0: Normal active state: navigate toward the exit while keeping the box. You normally have the box in hand; if you have voluntarily put it down, pick it up before stepping onto the exit. Reaching the exit while holding the box wins; reaching it empty-handed fails. A box-fall event moves you to the immediate recovery state u1.
u1: Immediate post-fall recovery state: the box has just slipped from your hands and is on the floor, with you turned to face it. Your very next move must be pickup. Do not turn, move, toggle, or wait, and do not enter the exit. A successful pickup earns 0.1 and returns you to normal state u0; ending the next step without the box outside the exit drops you into irrecoverable failure u3.
u2: Terminal success: you have reached the exit while holding the box. The task is complete and no further objective remains.
u3: Irrecoverable failure state: either you reached the exit without the box, or you failed to pick the box up immediately after it fell. No further reward is possible; the task cannot be recovered.
